notes.title: New Launch Date — Yooca: Next Horizon Early Access Coming November 21!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone 👋[/p][p]We’ve got an important update — our Early Access launch for *Yooca: Next Horizon* will now be happening on:[/p][p]🎯 **Friday, November 21, 2025**[/p][p]This gives us just a bit more time to polish, stabilize and make sure your first steps into the Yooca metaverse are amazing. 🌆🌐[/p][p]🛠️ Over the next few weeks, we’re adding:[/p][p]- Performance optimizations[/p][p]- Bug fixes and final polish[/p][p]- New starter experiences[/p][p]- Quality-of-life improvements based on early feedback[/p][p]🎥 Here’s a short video message from the team (and a sneak peek of what’s coming!):  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="u771AhBktMY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Thanks so much for wishlisting, following and supporting Yooca. We’re almost there — and we can’t wait to welcome you into the world of *Next Horizon*![/p][p]💜  [/p][p]Charles Tang[/p][p]CEO[/p][p]Youniverse Games[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🩺 Take Care of Your Vitals in Youniverse!
notes.notes:
[p]Your avatar now has 3 vital stats that affect how you look, move, and interact:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585319/7677e66627a482ce28dbd21368557d796eeb4310.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]💛[/b]Happiness – Reflects your mood and overall vibe.[/p][p]⬆️when you socialise, dance, explore, buy something fun, or do a good deed.[/p][p]⬇️if you're ignored, isolated, or idle too long.[/p][p][/p][p][b]⚡[/b]Energy – Affects how active and fast your avatar is.[/p][p]⬆️when you rest, eat, or chill in cozy spots.[/p][p]⬇️after too much running, playing, or skipping meals.[/p][p][/p][p]🧼 Hygiene – Shows how fresh (or funky) you are.[/p][p]⬆️when you shower, keep your home clean, or visit clean areas.[/p][p]⬇️over time, especially after outdoor activities or messy quests.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585319/21bb126e9717d9dee9bdc5da4f1f8904a5601819.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’re still improving this system — and we want your input![/p][p]👉What other actions do you think should affect Happiness, Energy, or Hygiene?[/p][p]Drop your ideas and help shape the Yooca experience![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Thank You for Sticking With Us 💖
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]We know you’re all looking forward to the launch—we are too! And we’re so close.
[/p][p]Right now, we’re in the final stretch, refining, polishing, and making sure everything feels just right. After multiple rounds of testing, we’ve made the tough call to push things back just a little. Not because we’re far off, but because we care about giving you the best possible experience from day one.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re a small, self-funded indie team, and every delay definitely stings, but quality matters more. We’re building something we deeply believe in, and your support means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’ve [i]wishlisted Yooca[/i], THANK YOU. Seriously. You're already a part of this world we’re creating, and we want you on this journey with us.
[/p][p]Come join us on [url="https://discord.gg/HTx5avfM"]https://discord.gg/HTx5avfM[/url] ! You’ll get sneak peeks, behind-the-scenes updates, and even a chance to shape some of what’s coming. We’d love to hear from you.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re almost there. Thanks for being here with us.❣️
[/p][p]— The Yooca Team[/p][p]
[/p]
